title: Baagi ba ba Ganeditseng Letsatsi la Boikhutso
intro: Kgato mo lefelong la bonno le le fa lotshitshing lwa lewatle koo taelo ya bomodimo e beetseng kwa thoko letsatsi le lengwe la kobamelo le go ikgapa. Setlhopha sengwe mo teng ga setšhaba seno se ne sa tlhopha go leka melelwane ya taelo eo ka leano le le boferefere, le le neng la felela ka phetogo e e neng e tla boeletsa mo dingwageng. Meya eno e ne e le bomang, mme go ne ga diragala eng ka yone?
clues: Re ne re nna gaufi le losi lwa lewatle, koo lewatle le neng le re tshedisa gone.
Re ne re laetswe go tlotla letsatsi le lengwe mo bekeng, re le beela kwa thoko mo ditirong tsa lefatshe.
Ka letsatsi leo, ditlhapi di ne tsa tla kwa go rona ka bontsi, jaaka e kete di re raela gore re tlole taelo.
Re ne ra loga leano la go tshwara ditlhapi tseno pele ga letsatsi le le boitshepo, re bo re di tsaya fa le sena go feta.
Fa bangwe mo gare ga rona ba ne ba tlhagisa kgatlhanong le tsietso eno, re ne ra itlhokomolosa kgakololo ya bone mme ra ganelela.
Ka ntlha ya tlolo ya rona, re ne ra fetolwa go nna dikgabo, ra nyatsega le go ganwa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
